data.name: FuncSummary_Today
data.value: 今天的日期（使用者所在時區）。
data.comment: Today's date in the user's time zone.

data.name: FuncSummary_Now
data.value: 目前的日期時間，與表單的日期時間欄位同一基準；要和這類欄位比較時使用。
data.comment: The current date and time, on the same basis as the form's date-and-time fields; use it to compare with one.

data.name: FuncSummary_UtcNow
data.value: 目前的 UTC 日期時間，不論在哪一端執行都相同。
data.comment: The current date and time in UTC, the same wherever the expression runs.

data.name: FuncSummary_IsBlank
data.value: 值是否沒有填：空白或只有空格的文字、空的關聯鍵、0，或沒有日期。
data.comment: Whether a value is not filled in: an empty or blank text, an empty key, zero, or no date.

data.name: FuncSummary_Between
data.value: 值是否介於兩個值之間（含兩端）；數字、日期、文字各自與同類比較。
data.comment: Whether a value lies between two others, both included; numbers, dates and texts each compare with their own kind.

data.name: FuncSummary_In
data.value: 值是否等於後面列出的其中一個值。
data.comment: Whether a value equals one of the values listed after it.

data.name: FuncSummary_DaysBetween
data.value: 從第一個日期到第二個日期的天數；第二個日期較早時為負數。
data.comment: The number of days from the first date to the second; negative when the second is earlier.

data.name: FuncSummary_MonthEnd
data.value: 日期所在月份的最後一天。
data.comment: The last day of a date's month.

data.name: FuncSummary_RegexMatch
data.value: 文字是否符合正規表示式；空的文字一律不符合。
data.comment: Whether a text matches a regular expression pattern; an empty text never matches.

data.name: FuncSummary_IsNullOrEmpty
data.value: 文字是否為空；IsBlank 也做同樣的判斷，並可檢查數字、關聯鍵與日期。
data.comment: Whether a text is empty; IsBlank does the same and also checks numbers, keys and dates.

data.name: FuncSummary_IsNullOrWhiteSpace
data.value: 文字是否為空或只有空白；IsBlank 也做同樣的判斷，並可檢查數字、關聯鍵與日期。
data.comment: Whether a text is empty or contains only spaces; IsBlank does the same and also checks numbers, keys and dates.
